items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued October 8 at 12:50PM PDT until October 9 at 2:00PM PDT by NWS Portland OR
items.description:
* WHAT...Seas 6 to 11 ft at 11 seconds and northwest winds 15 to
25 kt expected.

* WHERE...Coastal waters from Cape Shoalwater WA to Cape Falcon
OR out 10 NM.

* WHEN...From 8 AM to 2 PM PDT Friday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
